browser.emccVersion: emcc (Emscripten gcc/clang-like replacement + linker emulating GNU ld) 6.0.9 (4e4223852a0835923411059a3929907d7df1232e)

patches.reason: Execute the model-reader closure inline for single-threaded Emscripten, preserving native/pthread behavior.
Lower the two group-normalization entry points to existing NORM where equivalent, with CPU reference tests.
Do not misreport maxBufferSize as total/free GPU memory. Image callers must supply an explicit budget when live capacity is unknown.
Read unsplit GGUF metadata without whole-file size_t accumulation; preserve 64-bit file positions, validate metadata and leave tensor payloads lazy.
Keep a 64-bit logical metadata cursor; avoid tellg buffer invalidation and repeated FileReaderSync reads while retaining bounded skips and file checks.
Keep safetensors file positions 64-bit, bound/validate metadata and local shard paths, and load complete standard GGUF shard groups without file conversion.
Avoid an in-place Qwen timestep SiLU alias across a BF16 CPU matmul / WebGPU activation boundary. Preserve weights and arithmetic; no profile fallback or dtype conversion.
Report bounded allocation-time BF16 weight matmul placement through existing logs, without changing graph execution or reading tensor contents.
Convert only original BF16 parameters before WebGPU allocation to caller-selected F32 (default) or F16, preserving source files and other weight types.
Replace recursive graph-parent traversal with a heap-backed DFS stack, preserving order, compute flags and operand use counts for deep image graphs.
Give browser 3D convolution bias additions their own output when CPU convolution and WebGPU addition use different backends, preserving arithmetic and parameter types.
Use an equivalent supported 2D direct convolution for a single full-depth 3D window instead of CPU fallback, without changing parameter types or allocating a full im2col volume.

Expose idle on-demand runtime, borrowed configuration and separately labelled memory bookkeeping snapshots without adding generation-path instrumentation or GPU synchronization; own the omitted audio-encoder configuration path.

Add explicit default-off, bounded graph-stage logs to distinguish preparation, scheduler reserve including sync, weights, allocation, input copy and execution without extra native timing, graph walks or GPU synchronization.
Preserve external tensor address metadata while measuring scheduler graphs; avoid invalid sentinel alignment in WebGPU GET_ROWS support checks without changing weights or backend policy.

validation.browserSmokeScope: real-Wasm Worker, public records/callbacks, sparse GGUF/safetensors/shard I/O; test variants also check synthetic Qwen BF16 timestep and 3D convolution bias graph arithmetic on CPU (no GPU inference), plus deep graph construction/selection; no trained-model image generation
